reuse.why: Adds one guard helper next to the existing linkBankSyncAccount and calls it from every provider, though it is not folded into that shared link helper, so each of the five providers repeats the call.

duplication.why: The duplicate-link query and error are defined once; only the five three-line call sites are repeated, needed because the check must run before findOrCreateBank.

placement.why: Lives in accounts/app.ts with the other linking logic; it sits outside linkBankSyncAccount, which is defensible since bank creation happens before that helper is called.

scope.why: Only the guard and its calls are added.

maintainability.why: Clear single rule definition; minor weakness that syncSource is typed as string instead of the provider union linkBankSyncAccount uses, and a new provider must remember to add the call.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts, called by all five provider link functions
